the current structure of the Czech labor market does not correspond to the structure of the tertiary education system and that the Czech labor market is not able to absorb all university graduates.
the Czech Republic is not in the position to achieve the targets of employment and education of the EU 2020.
the Czech Republic has the problem with unemployment of young graduates, but this problem has a long history.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the question of whether the Czech Republic is ready for the implementation of the EU strategy of employment and training for labor market in the Czech Republic, which is the main objective of this paper.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the unemployment of university graduates in the Czech Republic is not only a consequence of economic crisis, but also a reflection of a long-term trend.
the current economic and political conditions of the Czech Republic are not conducive to the effective employment of graduates.
the Czech Republic has a high unemployment rate of graduates, which is not a consequence of the global economic crisis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Czech Republic is in the process of transition to the tertiary education and the tertiary education is the key to the development of the knowledge economy, which will be a prerequisite for the economic growth of the country.
the Czech Republic has to invest in education to increase the quality and quantity of human resources.
there is a need for a more active involvement of the state in the labor market, which would be a more effective way to solve the problem of unemployment of graduates in the Czech Republic.

the Czech labor market is still not sufficiently flexible to absorb the increasing number of graduates.
the Czech Republic should focus on reducing the unemployment of young people and increasing the number of graduates.
it is important to increase the quality of education in the Czech Republic in order to improve the quality of the workforce, which will have a positive impact on the economy and society.
